Internal APIs for running solfuzz inputs, fixtures, and SVM execution tests.

# Purpose
`fd_solfuzz.h` declares the internal API for running `solfuzz` test inputs against several Solana runtime targets. It defines the `fd_solfuzz_runner_t` object, which keeps the workspace, program cache, account database, and optional VM tracing state needed to execute inputs without global state. The file also declares constructor, delete, leak check, and demand-paged workspace functions, plus `*_run` and `*_fixture` entry points for instruction, transaction, block, ELF loader, syscall, VM interpreter, and bincode type tests.
